# True Love Creative

> Premium web, graphic and app design studio based in Dubai, UAE. High-end digital experiences since 2015. Serving clients worldwide.

## About

True Love Creative is a boutique design studio founded in 2015 and based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Founded by Javi Beat — a designer and creative director with over 10 years of experience in Dubai's creative industry — the studio specialises in crafting high-end digital experiences for artists, musicians, startups, and premium brands across the Middle East, Europe, and worldwide.

We believe design is not decoration — it is decision. Every project is built with the same conviction: that good design is the difference between being remembered and being ignored.

## Services

- **Web Design** — Custom websites with premium aesthetics, performance, and SEO. From artist portfolios to full-scale business platforms. Built with modern technologies (Next.js, React, Tailwind).
- **Graphic Design** — Visual identities, vinyl/album covers, event flyers, social media assets, and print design. Clients include internationally recognised DJs and musicians.
- **App Development** — Native and cross-platform mobile applications (iOS, Android) with thoughtful UX and clean architecture.
- **Brand Identity** — Complete branding systems: logos, typography, colour palettes, brand guidelines, and creative direction.
- **Creative Direction** — Art direction for campaigns, events, music releases, and digital products.
